read.pageTitle: Transaction Propagation and Isolation in Spring @Transactional (Baeldung)

facts.summary: Spring ho tro 7 propagation: REQUIRED (mac dinh, dung tx hien co hoac tao moi), SUPPORTS (dung tx neu co, khong thi non-tx), MANDATORY (bat buoc phai co tx, nguoc lai nem exception), NEVER (khong duoc co tx), NOT_SUPPORTED (suspend tx hien co), REQUIRES_NEW (luon tao tx moi, suspend tx cu), NESTED (savepoint trong tx hien co, chi DataSourceTransactionManager ho tro).

Isolation co 5 muc: DEFAULT (dung mac dinh cua RDBMS), READ_UNCOMMITTED (doc duoc uncommitted data, tat ca side effects), READ_COMMITTED (ngan dirty read, mac dinh Postgres/SQL Server/Oracle), REPEATABLE_READ (ngan dirty + non-repeatable read, mac dinh MySQL), SERIALIZABLE (ngan het, chay serial, giam concurrency).
facts.locator: muc 4.1-4.5, bang tac dong side effects

facts.summary: Uu tien gan @Transactional tu thap den cao: interface < superclass < class < interface method < superclass method < class method; class-level ap dung cho tat ca public method chua co annotation.

facts.summary: CrudRepository.save(entity) goi entityManager.persist() neu entity chua duoc persist (isNew() == true), nguoc lai goi entityManager.merge(). Spring Data JPA dung Version-property hoac Id-property de detect entity moi (mac dinh: version null hoac id null => new).

Entity co the implement Persistable<ID> va override isNew() de tu quy dinh logic phat hien entity moi; pattern thong dung la base class AbstractEntity voi @Transient boolean isNew = true, @PostPersist/@PostLoad dat isNew = false.

facts.topic: Muc tieu chinh cua Spring Boot
facts.summary: Spring Boot co 3 muc tieu: (1) Getting-started experience nhanh hon cho Spring development; (2) Opinionated out-of-the-box nhung get out of the way khi can tu chinh; (3) Cung cap non-functional features chung: embedded servers, security, metrics, health checks, externalized config.
